name: Dredge
fantasy: The harbour hauler. Reels you in on a rope, drops an anchor on you, and grows with every knock.
silhouette: the round brass helm and the rope drum on one shoulder

card.loop: Haul a foe in on the Grapnel, drop the Anchor on them, finish with the scattergun from behind. Every knock makes you bigger.
card.dash: Two charges of a shoulder barge. Turning is clumsy right after the Anchor.
card.passive: Knocks and assists pile up Salvage (+2.5% health each, up to 10). Hits from behind hurt 50% more. A knock heals you.
card.rmb: Throw a rope-hook through the first foe it meets (walls stop it) and reel them in; they land Grounded. Only the barge works while you reel.
card.e: Drop the Anchor in front of you: stun and slam. In the air it drives you down too.

weapons.shotgun: Seven slugs that stop at 5m; spread grows with each shot and the barge resets it.

passive.name: Salvage
passive.desc: Each knock or assist adds a Salvage stack (+2.5% health, 10 at most); being downed costs one. Hits on a hunter's back deal 50% more. Knocking a hunter heals you 16% of your health.

dash.name: Barge
dash.desc: A 4.6m shoulder barge (2 charges): shoves foes along it for 5. It is usable while reeling someone in. Just after the Anchor your turn is limited to 35 degrees.

variants.tap: Throw a rope-hook 11.5m: it stops at the first foe or wall. A foe is reeled to you (until it arrives or 3s pass) and lands Grounded for 1s. A swung body bends round you if you move; walls block the reel and the abyss takes whoever is pulled over it.

e.name: Anchor Drop
e.desc: A 0.22s wind-up, then the anchor smashes down in a 3m cone: 25 damage, stun 0.45s, slammed to the ground and Grounded. You are driven downward after it, unless you are over the abyss.

rank3.dash: pellet hits trim 0.25s off the barge recharge
rank3.sec: hitting a foe refunds 33% of the cooldown
rank3.kin: cast in the air, up to +75% damage by height

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 14s -> 9s; hitting a foe refunds 33% of it.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 12s -> 8.4s; pellet hits trim 0.25s off the recharge.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 10s -> 7s, damage +30%; cast in the air, up to +75% damage by height.

tells.half: brass glints along the shoulder drum from 5 stacks
tells.full: 10 stacks: a brass halo ring at the feet and a bell within 20m
